description: Splits the spectrum into frequency bands and processes each independently, per a datafile of band recipes: 'lofrq hifrq bitflag [amp1 amp2 [+]transpose]'. The 4-bit bitflag enables, per band: bit 1 amplitude change (amp1), bit 2 amplitude ramp amp1->amp2 across the file, bit 3 partial transposition (frq multiplier, or '+value' = Hz shift added), bit 4 ADD transposed partials to the original instead of replacing. Verified: '200 800 1000 0.5' (band attenuation) and '200 800 0010 1.5' (band transposed up a fifth) both exit 0 with distinct renders. Static duration (2.0230); deterministic. Operates on PVOC analysis files (.ana).
musical_use: A per-register spectral mixing desk and shifter in one pass: rebalance registers (duck the low band, lift presence), ramp bands in/out over the file's length (bit 2 - written into the data, no breakpoint files needed), or detune/shift chosen registers only. Multiplicative transposes (bit 3) keep harmonicity within the band; '+Hz' shifts make a band inharmonic against the rest - selective bell-ification of just the top of a sound. Bit 4 layers the shifted copy over the original band for thickening. Because every band is one text line, complex multi-band treatments are easy to generate programmatically. For plain band ISOLATION prefer hilite filter (mode 7) or greq; band earns its keep when bands get different treatments.

banddata.description: Text file, one band per line: 'lofrq hifrq bitflag [amp1 amp2 [+]transpose]' (write with write_data_file()). bitflag is 4 binary digits, e.g. '1000' amp change (needs amp1), '1100' amp ramp (needs amp1 amp2), '0010' transpose (needs multiplier, or '+200' for a 200 Hz shift), '0011' transpose ADDED to the original. Values must be present exactly as the bitflag demands (banner rule). Verified working lines: '200 800 1000 0.5' and '200 800 0010 1.5'.

examples.description: Attenuate the low band, shift the mids up a fifth.
examples.expected_use: First write_data_file('bands.txt', '100 400 1000 0.4\n800 3000 0010 1.5') - two independent band treatments in one pass.

examples.description: Ramp a presence band in over the file.
examples.expected_use: write_data_file('ramp.txt', '2000 6000 1100 0.2 2.0') - the band swells from 0.2x to 2x across the duration.

known_issues: The bitflag dictates exactly which extra values each line must carry - missing/extra values fail the datafile read.
Amplitude ramps (bit 2) span the WHOLE file per band - for arbitrary contours use spec gain breakpoints on an isolated band instead.
